artifacts.summary: Re-derives (C)'s general row against the tree, confirms T2 positive, reduces HitPresented to a combinatorial statement about bi-infinite words, and finds an elementary sorry-free route (Ramsey over a finite composing sigma-star profile) with an exhibited count bound, plus a four-layer plan decomposition.

next_steps: Plan the positive theorem in four layers (profile monoid; bounded representatives; one-sided periodic transport in both orientations; gadget assembly and headline), landing the profile composition law first; decide file scope (one large HitComplete.lean vs sibling modules under RaySummary/).

memory_candidates.content: First-order k-types of words (KType = NormalForm -> Bool) do not determine membership in L_sigma^+ or L_alpha L_sigma^*; to transport a factorization along a Ramsey block repetition, colour Ramsey pairs with a finite composing 'sigma-star profile' g_sigma(w) = {(type p, type q) : w = p m q, m in L_sigma^*} plus the cut-profile, and compare blocks block-by-block through the composition law. No idempotent or Buchi/automata theorem is needed.

Repeating one literal segment of a seam trace as a lasso period can realize family triples the trace lacks (cut-pair obstruction: k-type cut pairs are a depth-(k+1) datum); the fixture route of hit-presented-model-a/node does not generalize, and HitPresented satisfiability is exactly: every seam triple has a bi-ultimately-periodic realization whose triples are all seam triples.
